title: सत्य सन्देशहरू
description: Lekhnath Paudyal's poem "सत्य सन्देशहरू" is a three-part sequence of dated verse "messages," each closing with its own Sharada-journal colophon, presenting paradoxical reflections on darkness, light, lightness, and culpability in worldly existence.

rights.basis: Author died 1966; public domain since 2016 (Nepal's Copyright Act 2059: life + 50 years). Verify before publishing.
